metadata.datasource: Characteristic curves, spectral sensitivities, dye spectra from Kodak H-1-5245 (3-99) and its edition H-1-5245t (5-03), EASTMAN EXR 50D Color Negative Film 5245/7245, ECN-2, Status M; curves and sensitivities from the 1999 plots, the dyes, neutral and D-min from the 2003 edition's. The curves were read from the vector plot, each layer by its order at the dense end, and converted from Status M densities into dye amounts. Mid-grey at the normal exposure, log H -0.695 lux-seconds: camera stop 0 on the 2003 edition's camera-stop scale over the same curves, which is Kodak's 10/EI (0.202 lux-seconds at EI 50). Past the sheet's last plotted exposure each curve continues at its final gradient for 0.8 decades (R 0.50, G 0.63, B 0.60), where the plot ends a few stops over normal and the film goes on. The sheet's sensitivity shapes continue on the donor's tails beyond the plotted range and are balanced so an 18% grey exposes every layer equally. The base density is the sheet's own D-min spectral density, base and fog, and the profile keeps its midscale neutral. No spectral adaptation window: agx fits one to each of its own stocks' sensitivities. DIR coupler model from 'kodak_vision3_50d'.
